skill.name: real-estate-marketing-specialist
skill.description: Plan property inquiry, viewing, listing-alert and real-estate service marketing with capture forms, consent-based segments and follow-up journeys. Use for marketing, not housing eligibility, tenant screening, lending or transaction decisions.
skill.summary: Draft consent-based property campaigns with minimal capture forms, explicit audience rules, follow-up journeys and launch checks.
skill.author: email-marketing-skills-hub

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:16 requests verification of listing status, price, photo rights and disclosures before drafting an offer. This is property marketing validation, not host enumeration or system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Property campaigns can promote stale listings, confuse viewing requests with appointments and mix inquiries with marketing permission. This skill guides campaign drafts with minimal capture fields, explicit audience rules and launch checks.
actual_capabilities: Draft campaign briefs for property alerts, viewing requests, seller consultations and neutral market guides.
Propose minimal capture fields using volunteered property preferences without sensitive screening data.
Define interest-based segments with permission exclusions, missing-data handling and service-stage rules.
Design follow-up journeys with listing verification, contact-and-listing deduplication, exits and re-entry conditions.
Specify campaign metrics, launch blockers and preview cases for duplicate, suppressed, stale and converted records.
Plan checks to cancel or suppress queued promotions when listing availability changes.
limitations: Provides planning guidance and draft content, not a bundled integration or autonomous campaign sender.
Cannot establish current listing availability, appointment confirmation or provider capabilities without verified external information.
Does not authorize housing eligibility, tenant screening, lending, offers, contracts or property transactions.
Does not certify legal compliance; local housing advertising requirements need qualified review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a viewing inquiry campaign
use_cases.description: Draft a viewing request form and acknowledgment journey while keeping appointment confirmation in the authoritative listing or CRM system.

use_cases.title: Separate listing alerts from service messages
use_cases.description: Define permission-based listing segments and follow-up rules without treating an inquiry as permission for a general newsletter.

use_cases.title: Review campaign launch readiness
use_cases.description: Test missing consent, duplicate inquiries, withdrawn listings and queued promotions before approving automation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a viewing acknowledgment
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an acknowledgment for [listing] using [verified details]. State that the viewing request is pending confirmation. Do not add newsletter enrollment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create one service acknowledgment draft.

prompt_templates.title: Design a minimal inquiry form
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a property inquiry form for [brokerage]. Use volunteered area, property type, budget and timing preferences. Separate optional listing-alert permission from the viewing request.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: define capture fields and purpose-specific copy.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an inquiry journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an inquiry journey for [CRM] using [anonymized schema]. Include eligibility, missing-data handling, contact-and-listing deduplication, appointment checks, exits and metrics. Identify unverified provider behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: map a draft journey to an existing system.

prompt_templates.title: Audit campaign launch logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [draft rules] against [synthetic cases]. Test opt-outs, conflicting consent, duplicates, stale listings, queued messages and conversions. Return blockers and corrections. Do not activate anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: evaluate release readiness without executing changes.

output_examples.input: Draft a viewing request acknowledgment for synthetic listing L-104. The requested Saturday time is not confirmed.
output: Subject: Viewing request received for listing L-104
Thank you for your interest in listing L-104. Your requested Saturday viewing is pending availability confirmation.
An agent will follow up after checking the listing and appointment schedule.
Draft only. This inquiry does not enroll the contact in listing alerts or a newsletter.

output_examples.input: Outline release checks for a listing-alert journey using synthetic contacts and listing records.
output: Eligibility: require explicit listing-alert permission and matching declared property interests. Hold unknown or conflicting permission for review.
Exclusions: suppress unsubscribed, complained and blocked contacts outside audience OR conditions. Recheck eligibility before each marketing send.
Listing state: verify availability before sending. Cancel or suppress queued promotions for withdrawn, rented or sold listings.
Deduplication: use contact and listing ID together. Preserve independent alert preferences when a specific listing exits.
Launch blocker: do not activate if exclusions or listing refresh cannot be trusted.

best_practices: Provide anonymized field schemas, synthetic records and verified listing facts before requesting a campaign plan.
Keep service requests separate from optional marketing permission, and recheck eligibility before every marketing send.
Review stale listings, queued messages, missing data and duplicate cases before granting scoped launch authorization.
anti_patterns: Treating a property inquiry or saved tag as permission for unrelated marketing.
Inferring protected traits or using marketing segments to rank housing applicants.
Publishing forms or sending campaigns from draft assumptions without verified availability and explicit authorization.

faq.question: Does this skill send campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: No. It defaults to plans and local drafts. Publishing, uploading contacts or sending campaigns requires explicit authorization for the target and scope.

faq.question: Can it confirm viewing appointments?
faq.answer: It can draft the request journey. Confirmation depends on verified availability in the authoritative listing or appointment system.

faq.question: Can it screen tenants or assess loan eligibility?
faq.answer: No. Housing eligibility, applicant ranking, tenant screening and lending decisions are outside its scope.

faq.question: Does it require Poptin?
faq.answer: No. Poptin is an optional capture tool when it addresses a documented gap. The skill favors preserving the existing stack.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide campaign goals, verified listing details, permission rules and anonymized system fields. Use synthetic examples instead of exporting personal records.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee housing advertising compliance?
faq.answer: No. It identifies review needs and discourages discriminatory targeting. Jurisdiction-specific requirements require authoritative sources and qualified review.
